provider: Dr. Ramdayal Munda Tribal Welfare Research Institute, Department of Welfare, Government of Jharkhand

verified.institutional_scope: TRI states it was established in 1953, is funded by Government of Jharkhand and Ministry of Tribal Affairs, and undertakes tribal research plus preservation/promotion of tribal language, art, craft and culture.
verified.museum_locator: TRI homepage -> Tribal Museum: museum houses dioramas depicting traditional livelihoods of the 32 tribes of Jharkhand.
verified.external_government_museum_catalogue: Museums of India catalogue: Tribal Museum at Dr Ram Dayal Munda Tribal Welfare Research Institute, Tagore Hill Road, Ranchi; anthropology museum; describes dioramas of 32 Jharkhand tribes.
verified.munda_scope: A secondary contemporary report explicitly states that Munda models are among the museum chambers; treat this only as a discovery/provenance lead until TRI exposes a Munda-specific object/diorama catalogue record.

promotion.reason: Institutional museum existence and collection scope are verified, but current TRI pages inspected do not expose an exact Munda object/diorama identifier or provenance record. Museum representation must not be converted into generalized cultural fact.

deduplication: TRI homepage, About, museum/gallery pages and Museums of India institutional catalogue are access/metadata manifestations for the same museum institution; do not count them as independent cultural corroboration.
note: No cultural proposition or count is promoted from generic museum descriptions.
